prompt_md: 3 red and 3 black cards are shuffled and turned over one by one. Before each, you guess its color, playing as well as possible. On average, how many do you get right?
prompt_short: 3 red, 3 black. Guess each color with best play. Average right?
hint_md: Always guess the color with more cards left. How often is there a tie?
explain_intuition_md: Each card is a coin flip at first, so 3 right out of 6 is tempting. But you can count: guess the color with more cards left, and you're right more than half the time whenever the counts are uneven. The last card, for one, is always a sure thing.
